senses.gloss: m.(b. h. associate; Talm. = חוֹבֵר, v. חָבַר)

units: <cite ref="Devarim Rabbah 7">Deut. R. s. 7</cite>; a. e.

<cite ref="Shabbat 11a:8">Sabb. 11ᵃ</cite> <he>תחת נכרי ולא תחת ח׳</he> (v. Rabb. D. S. a. l. note 80) rather under heathen (Roman) government, than under a Parsee.—Pl. <he>חַבָּרִין</he>, <he>חַבָּרִים</he>.
<cite ref="Kiddushin 72a:10">Kidd. 72ᵃ</cite> <he>הראני ח׳</he> let me see (give me a description of) the Parsees (as opposed to Persians).
<cite ref="Yevamot 63b:9">Yeb. 63ᵇ</cite> (ref. to <cite ref="Deuteronomy 32:21">Deut. XXXII, 21</cite> <he>גוי נבל</he>) <he>אלו ח׳</he> this means the Parsees.
